description: Lab evaluation fixtures, run against evals/fixtures/repo. The scripted user answers every card with its recommendation unless an override names the question; revisions re-answer an earlier question after a later one is answered. See src/lab-eval.ts.

fixtures.name: clear-feature
fixtures.text:
Import bookmarks from a browser HTML export

Users want `bookmarks import <file.html>` to read the Netscape bookmark HTML that browsers export and add each link, turning the folders it sits in into tags.

fixtures.name: bug
fixtures.text:
Removing a bookmark deletes the wrong one

I ran `bookmarks list`, then `bookmarks remove 1`, and a different bookmark disappeared.

fixtures.name: escalation
fixtures.text:
Tags are lost when two commands run at once

I tagged a bookmark from one terminal while a script was adding bookmarks in another, and the tag was gone afterwards.
